title: SessionStorage Function-call via innerHTML
description: DOM-based XSS where a value read from sessionStorage is passed as an argument into a rendering function that assigns it to innerHTML.
objectives: Trace how the 'msg' key flows from sessionStorage.getItem() through renderMessage(...) into innerHTML.
Recognize that innerHTML does not execute injected <script> tags directly — you need an event-based gadget.
Note that this value only persists for the current tab's session, unlike the localStorage equivalent of this case.
hints: renderMessage(value) assigns value straight to element.innerHTML — plain
Reset the state with sessionStorage.removeItem('msg') or sessionStorage.clear().
body:
SessionStorage -> innerHTML (function-call context)

Set sessionStorage.msg; it is passed through renderMessage() before reaching the DOM.
